# S1.4 — Land the Harness IR — HIR/1 (§3.1, R-2.1.2)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §3.1 (R-2.1.2) · ADR-0015/0016/0017/0018 (as amended) ·
ADR-0216 (interim `classify_home`) · **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/008_S1.4__harness-ir-dialect.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.1.2**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.3` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the C0/Stage-1 §3.1 Harness IR as a new **persistent** workspace crate
`crates/hh-hir` — the E1 *build binding* (CC4). HIR/1 is a closed dialect: exactly the
**13 entity kinds**, **2 opaque leaves**, and **7 edge kinds** of §3.1.3, every node and edge
carrying a `provenance: ProvenanceRecord` and a version record, `since = HIR/1` on every
kind. The full operation surface is executable — `validate` (the complete §3.1.4 battery),
`canonicalize`, `identity` (semantic + version ids over idp/1), `seal` (all refs pinned,
definition authority conferred, closed-world tool set computed), `diff`/`apply`/`invert`/
`classify`, identity-only `migrate`, and `project` — and every op runs **out-of-process over
canonical bytes** through `hh-ir-op` (AC-IR-10).

**Closes DF-S1.1-1** (the fifteen-row per-kind `classify_home` table is published in
`hh-ontology` and total), **DF-S1.3-1** (provenance is a required field on every node/edge;
`MissingProvenance` on parse and validate), and **DF-S1.3-3** (a sealed definition's
closed-world `ToolCapability` declarations mint `environment` through
`MintingContext`/`default_authority_in`).

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-hir/`** (new, persistent workspace member; sits **above** ontology/identity/
  provenance/wire — its only deps; no edge to the Hosting ABI, AC-IR-04). Modules:
  `kinds` (the 13 entities / 7 edges / closed `ToolEffects`/`Mutability`/`World`/… sums),
  `leaves` (`Text`, `CompiledPayload` + `DeclaredInterface`), `records` (per-kind records,
  `SurfaceRecord`, `AgentProcess` native/hosted sum, `OpaqueProcess`,
  `CapabilityDeclarationRecord`, `AssumptionDebtRecord`), `refs` (`Ref`,
  `RefVersion::{Pinned,Selector}`, `ProfileRef`), `document` (`HirDocument`, `Node`,
  `Edge`), `schema` (canonical-JSON to/from, unknown-variant refusal, `MissingProvenance`
  on parse), `identity` (semantic/version ids, edge ids, opaque version identity — all
  idp/1), `validate` (the §3.1.4 battery → typed `HirError`s), `ops` (`canonicalize`,
  `seal`, `migrate`, `project`, the `*_bytes` canonical seam), `diff` (`HirDiff`,
  `DiffOp`, `apply`, `invert`, `classify`), `bin/hh-ir-op` (the out-of-process driver).
- **`crates/hh-ontology/`** — `planes::IR_ENTITY_KINDS`: the fifteen-row §3.1.3
  `classify_home` table (13 entities + 2 leaves); `classify_home`/`classify_home_identifier`
  are total over every registered kind. Leaf homes are interim under ADR-0216/OQ-467
  (`Text`→P1, `CompiledPayload`→P2; ADR-0231).
- **`crates/hh-provenance/`** — `MintingContext{closed_world_tools}` +
  `default_authority_in` (CC8 additive; `default_authority` delegates with the empty
  context): `Origin::tool` mints `environment` iff the capability is declared closed-world
  in the sealed definition; the `external` floor and R-TEXT cap are unchanged.
- **`crates/hh-wire/`** — `canonical::parse_canonical`: the canonical-form byte checker
  (sorted members, no whitespace, no duplicate keys, integer-only) that `NonCanonicalInput`
  and the out-of-process seam share.
- **`crates/hh-identity/`** — `kinds`: the HIR-domain tags the id projection needs.
- **Build memory:** `docs/adr/ADR-0231`, `ADR-0232` (+ regenerated index);
  `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — `DF-S1.1-1`, `DF-S1.3-1`, `DF-S1.3-3` → DONE;
  `docs/build/runs/S1.4.md`; `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` + `docs/build/LEDGER.md`.

## Design decisions
- **Seal order (ADR-0231).** Member `version_id`s are computed over the authored
  (pre-pin) canonical form, then every `Ref` is pinned to the target member's id. A
  topological pin-then-hash pass cannot exist — `Permission.holder ↔
  AgentProcess.permissions` is cyclic by construction (CF-076). The pin is the
  definition's binding of a ref to a member identity, not member content.
- **Closed-world minting (ADR-0232).** `seal` populates
  `SealedDefinition.closed_world_tools` from the document's own `ToolCapability`
  declarations (`Pure`, or every declared effect `world = closed`);
  `minting_context()` hands the set to `default_authority_in`. No global closed-world
  registry — the declaration is definitional.
- **Quoted diff paths (ADR-0231).** Map keys containing `.`/`[`/`]` emit as
  `["escaped key"]` so budget dimensions like `tokens.total` round-trip through
  `diff`/`apply`.
- **Identity-only `migrate`.** `migrate(doc, from, to)` is the identity over `HIR/1 →
  HIR/1`; any other dialect pair is `DialectUnsupported`. Real migration lands with the
  first dialect bump (CC8).

## Test evidence
- `cargo test --workspace` — **313 passed / 0 failed** (`hh-hir` 52: 10 unit, 19 validate
  matrix, 12 seal/identity, 7 corpus, 4 CLI).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` — clean; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets
  --all-features -- -D warnings` — 0 warnings.
- **AC-IR-01** exact roster + `since = HIR/1` + closed sums + every §3.1.4 invariant a
  `validate` check (20 checks enumerated in `checks_run`).
- **AC-IR-02** (Stage-1 half) two-profile tool differs only in `surface`; the
  `model_identity_statics` check rejects model-identity-typed semantic fields outside
  `ProfileRef`.
- **AC-IR-04** no Hosting-ABI dependency; `OpaqueProcess` defined in the IR.
- **AC-IR-05** rename/reorder/reword ⇒ `semantic_ops = 0`, `semantic_id` unchanged.
- **AC-IR-06** 120-definition corpus: `canonicalize` byte-identical across re-parse and
  node reordering; `apply(base, diff)` = target, `apply(target, invert)` = base.
- **AC-IR-07** `EffectUncovered`, `ConditionedRuleIncomplete`, delegation/budget
  attenuation failures all green.
- **AC-IR-10** all nine ops over canonical bytes through `hh-ir-op`, byte-equal to
  in-crate results; non-canonical input refused.

## Out of scope (spec staging, not gaps)
`opacity`/`ablate` (Stage 3), `rebase` (C1), OpaqueProcess population/probing and
agent-spec export/import (C2/Stage 4), the AC-IR-02 compiled-profile half and
AC-IR-03/-08/-09 (Stage 3/4 criteria).
